title: One interface for every decision model, and one function to compare them on the same decisions
request: Milestone D: decision models of any kind (a classical classifier, an open-source model, a hosted one) answer DCLab's decision points through one interface and are judged by the same measures against the rules.
spec: A DecisionAnswerer protocol in dclab_core: a point, its state and its options in; an answer with a confidence, or an abstention, out. Registered with its name, version and points; the ledger records every answerer's answer beside the rule's. Done when a scripted answerer, the rule and a classical classifier answer the same recorded decisions, and their agreement and accuracy come out of one function.
plan: The protocol, a registry, the recorded rule, a scripted answerer and a logistic-regression classifier.
compare(): coverage, agreement with the rule, accuracy where a label says what was right.
with_answers(): shadow answers recorded beside the rule's, never used.

decisions.decision: The rule is the answer recorded with each decision, not the code run again.
decisions.why: The code saw the table; the state holds only bands, so a replay from the state would be a different rule.

decisions.decision: Shadow answers are marked and set aside when deciding what counts as right.
decisions.why: An answer nobody saw must not turn a person's agreement into a contradiction, and so into a label.

change: dclab_core/answerers.py (new; dclab-core 0.17.0); tests/test_answerers.py (new); CHANGELOG, CLAUDE.md, the plan, the roadmap.

findings.defect: Numbers entered the classifier unscaled, and it lost on a perfectly separable small measure.
findings.scenario: A lift of a few hundredths separating the labels: below chance on held-out projects.
findings.cause: Raw units in a regularised model beside 0/1 bands.
findings.fix: A scaler fitted on the training rows inside the classifier.

findings.defect: A classifier could read the very measure its label was computed from.
findings.scenario: A measured leakage label is true exactly when the state's lift is above zero.
findings.cause: Every numeric state field became a feature.
findings.fix: exclude= on the classifier and features(); names never enter whole.

findings.scenario: 'maybe' recorded as an answer to a yes/no point; the ledger would then skip the record on read.
findings.fix: Answers the point refuses are abstentions; the record is validated again; register checks who may answer.

findings.defect: A shadow answer changed which label counted as the truth.
findings.scenario: A person agreeing with the rule became a contradiction once a shadow disagreed.
findings.cause: effective_label counts an exposed label against any non-person answer.
findings.fix: Shadows are marked and set aside when the truth is read.

findings.defect: The classifier answered options the decision never offered.
findings.scenario: split.strategy answered 'time' when only 'random' was an option.
findings.fix: Restricted to the offered options, renormalised; abstains when none remains.

findings.defect: Accuracy flattered an answerer that abstains.
findings.scenario: Answering half the cases and getting those right showed 1.0.

findings.defect: The test's win over the rule was planted and not said so.
findings.scenario: The state's band is set from the label; the rule reads only the name.
findings.cause: Generated data meant to exercise the plumbing.
findings.fix: Said in the test and the status line.

measurements.name: planted faults
measurements.gate: each fix undone fails a test

outcome: Every decision model now answers through one interface and is compared with the rule on the same decisions: coverage, agreement and accuracy, overall and by point. Shadow answers are recorded without moving the truth.
lessons: Scale features inside the fitted model, or small measures lose to counts.
A label computed from a state field turns that field into the answer: leave it out.
Say when a test's winner is planted: it proves plumbing, not quality.
risks: No real decisions have been compared yet: generated benchmarks come with 22.1.
